good_thing: (Southeastern North Carolina): The local Clear the Shelters campaign placed more than 830 animals with families, setting a local record. Sulu, a dog who had spent more than 300 days at Paws Place Dog Rescue, was among them. He joined Jamison and Alex Cannon and their twin daughters for story time.
current_or_history: On September 8, 2001, the first National Book Festival opened with a short morning ceremony on the Library of Congress’s Neptune Plaza. Its poster held a quiet extra detail: artist Lu Ann Barrow painted herself into the foreground in a red floral-print dress.
tiny_fact: Sea otters have loose folds of skin under each forearm that work like pockets. They can use them to carry a snack for later.
thought: A small piece of good news still counts, even if it does not make much noise.
